## Key subsystems

- `crates/reasonbraid-core/` — the domain-model crate (`KICKOFF.md` §3): strong identifiers, command/event envelopes, minimal thread/participation/provider-attempt state machines, typed errors + the §9.8 reason-code registry (WP1 complete), the authority model landed in WP5 `.5.1` (`src/authority.rs`: the `EnrollmentAuthorityBoundary` ceiling, scoped `AuthorityGrant`s, the deterministic `grant_exceeds_boundary` subset checker, liveness helpers, the SHA-256 `policy_digest`, `AuthorizationDecisionRecord`), and the budget model in `.5.2` (`src/budget.rs`: fail-closed `BudgetDimensions`, total fallible arithmetic, the `ReservationReference` the supervisor verifies before dispatch). Entry point `src/lib.rs`; envelopes in `src/envelope.rs` (golden fixtures/schemas under `fixtures/` and `schema/`); lifecycles in `src/state.rs`; errors in `src/error.rs`. Owner: repo-local workflow.
- `crates/reasonbraid-server/` — the control-plane crate (`KICKOFF.md` §3), landed in WP2 and extended in WP3 `.3.2`, WP5, WP6 `.6.1`, and WP6 `.6.2`: `.2.1` `apply_command` writes idempotency + event + state + outbox in one PostgreSQL transaction (claim-first idempotency); `.2.2` the leased outbox worker (`src/outbox.rs`: `claim_ready`/`deliver`/`complete`, each phase its own commit, per-claim fencing token + caller-supplied lease clock); `.3.2` the node channel (`src/node_channel.rs`: durable per-node inbox with a monotonic cursor, replay from the node's reported cursor, deduplicated node-event receipts, handshake directives, axum routes over `/v1/nodes/*`); `.5.1` the authority engine (`src/authority.rs`: the boundary ceiling + scoped grants, `create_grant` refuses overreaching grants, `authorize` writes the audit row for allowances AND denials, `apply_authorized_command` commits the record with the `.2.1` writes in one transaction); `.5.2` the budget engine (`src/budget.rs`: `create_reservation` atomic against the held amount, denial rows, `settle_reservation` with overrun reporting, `release_reservation`; `migrations/0005_budget.sql`); `.6.1` the thread domain (`src/threads.rs`: typed operation bodies, the projection in `aggregate_state.state`, core-machine validation, dev rules) and the control API (`src/api.rs`: enroll bootstrap, `/v1/threads` command/query surface, the trusted dev principal header, typed §9.8 errors, one-transaction command flow via the `tx` claim/apply split) plus the `rb-server` binary (`src/bin/rb-server.rs`); `.6.2` the node wiring (invite/challenge dispatch work items + best-effort reservations in the command transaction; node `work_result` events fold into the thread through `apply_node_result_in_tx` keyed on the inbox command id, with in-tx settlement; in-tx channel/budget variants). Schema at repository-root `migrations/` (0001 atomic transaction, 0002 worker columns + dedupe sink, 0003 node inbox/events, 0004 authority, 0005 budget, 0006 enrollments); proof via `scripts/run_pg_tests.sh` (ephemeral server + the two-host demo) and the `pg-tests` CI job. Owner: repo-local workflow.
- `crates/reasonbraid-cli/` — the WP6 command-line surface (`KICKOFF.md` §3), landed in `.6.1`: the `rb` binary (enroll, thread create/invite/contribute/challenge/revise/close, inspect) over the control API's HTTP JSON. `src/lib.rs` is the testable body (config from `REASONBRAID_SERVER`/`REASONBRAID_CLI_STATE` with a repo-local state dir default, the name→principal/thread→tenant state file, the HTTP client, one `run_*` per verb); `src/main.rs` is thin clap glue. The end-to-end suite (`tests/cli_end_to_end.rs`, in the `pg-tests` job) drives the REAL binary against an in-process API on live PostgreSQL and inspects everything through CLI output — the "no database surgery" acceptance. Owner: repo-local workflow.
- `crates/reasonbraid-node/` — the Rust node crate (`KICKOFF.md` §3), landed in WP3 and extended in WP4 `.4.1` and WP6 `.6.2`: `.3.1` the SQLite node journal (`src/journal.rs` — WAL + `synchronous=FULL` verified at open and recorded in `journal_meta`; boundary-before-boundary ordering: `record_dispatch` commits before the adapter runs; `recover` → honest `outcome_unknown`, `prove_result`/`reconcile` exits; command/operation dedupe, `attempt_transitions` boundary ledger, outgoing events + ack cursor; schema embedded at `migrations/`) and the read-only `rb-journal` inspection CLI (`src/bin/rb-journal.rs`; `.6.2` adds the `events` view — original ids + payloads); `.3.2` the outbound channel client (`src/channel.rs`, HTTP/1 JSON over loopback) and the lifecycle facade (`src/node.rs`: `Offline → Reconciling → Schedulable` — schedulable only after the reconnect handshake is fully applied); `.4.1` the execution supervisor and `.5.2` its budget gate (`src/supervisor.rs`: `execute_attempt` journals every boundary, lands attempts on their honest terminal, and REQUIRES a `ReservationReference` + `LocalBudget` headroom before the dispatch boundary); `.6.2` the work loop (`src/worker.rs`: poll → journal → execute work items whose attempt is absent or `prepared` — never a silent retry — and emit `work_result` events for completed attempts) and the `rb-node` worker binary. Kill-point (KP-1…KP-9), CLI, and supervisor tests run in plain `cargo test` (file-based SQLite, in-process fake); the cross-crate channel tests run in the `pg-tests` job; `scripts/demo_two_host.sh` drives the real binary with real kill points. Owner: repo-local workflow.
- `crates/reasonbraid-adapter/` — the harness adapter boundary (`KICKOFF.md` §3), landed in WP4 `.4.1`: the capability-declaring `Adapter` contract (`src/contract.rs` — dispatch ack ≠ completion, no credential field, unsupported status lookup is an honest fact, never retry advice), the deterministic scripted `FakeAdapter` (`src/fake.rs` — stream/fail/hang/ignore-cancel/lose-response, no sleeps: the hang is a cancellation Notify), and the sanitized ten-fixture outcome corpus (`src/fixtures.rs` + `fixtures/*.json`, mechanically credential-scanned and coverage-checked). `.4.2` qualified the first REAL harness: `CodexCliAdapter` (`src/codex.rs`) supervises `codex exec --json` as a subprocess (streamed thread id attached as the provider handle, honest `Unsupported` status lookup, `BestEffort` cancel, token receipts → exact usage; live test env-gated `RB_LIVE_CODEX=1`). `.7` lands the WP7 deliberation benchmark (`src/bench/` + `src/bin/rb-bench.rs` + `bench/v1/` corpus/prompts): four workflows over the contract with deterministic graders (never an LLM judge), a corpus that carries its own scoring oracle (the `tests/bench_harness.rs` self-test), no independence score, spread-bearing aggregates, factual-only Brier, and an env-gated call-budgeted real mode. Vendor specifics stay inside the adapter crate, never in `reasonbraid-core`. Owner: repo-local workflow.
